guarantees.claim: ctr_we[i] is continuously assigned to the value of sp2v_sig_chk[5+i] for each i from 0 to NumSlicesCtr-1.

assumptions.claim: sp2v_sig_chk must have a bit width of at least 5+NumSlicesCtr to avoid out-of-range indexing.
assumptions.risk: Out-of-range indexing may cause synthesis error or unpredictable simulation behavior.

assumptions.claim: ctr_we must be at least NumSlicesCtr bits wide to safely receive all assigned bits.
assumptions.risk: Assignment to non-existent bits may be truncated or cause compilation failure, potentially breaking counter control logic.

uncertain_points.claim: When NumSlicesCtr is 0, the generate loop produces no assignment, leaving the entire ctr_we bus undriven.
uncertain_points.risk: Undriven ctr_we may propagate X values into counter control, causing unpredictable AES behaviour or potential security weakness.
